author: Adrian
text: Nightly sweep (Oct 12): Kevin forwarded the 'VBX Final documents' thread at 1:12 PM. Dana rejected Steve's Oct 12 Section 14 redline and restated the deal as Pledge 100% / Call Option 77.24% / Management 100% then 85%, with a 2 PM window to reverse the changes before DocuSign. Item retitled, priority raised to critical, prompt refreshed. The earlier 41.8%-cap framing is superseded. Decision for Adrian and Kevin: keep Section 14 and risk the signing, or accept Dana's structure with a narrower protection for the 22.76%.
